## About
TheAiExpert.ai is an AI consulting practice founded by Erik Schwartz in London.
Services focus on fractional Chief AI Officer (CAIO) support, AI strategy, and
implementation for SMBs and mid-market enterprises in the UK, Europe, and global remote.

## Services
- Fractional Chief AI Officer (CAIO)
- AI strategy and roadmapping

- Prompt fluency and AI skills training

## Ideal Clients
- Businesses in London, UK, and Europe starting or scaling AI adoption
- Organisations needing part-time / fractional AI leadership
- Executives who want practical, ROI-focused AI guidance
- Teams that need training in effective AI use and prompt design
